name: Outslug Sprint
text:
**Outslug Sprint** (Combat)

You can make quick, defensive movements.

**Prerequisites**: Int 13; Combat Expertise or brawler’s cunning class feature; Lunge; Outslug Style; Outslug Weave; Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.

**Benefit**: While using Outslug Style, you can move an additional 5 feet when making a 5-foot step.
